item.title: Frequently Asked Questions
item.description:
Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

📦 Products & Quality

Q: What products do you supply?

A: We specialize in door hardware including:

  • Door Handles (Stainless Steel, Zinc Alloy, Aluminum)
  • Door Locks (Mortise Locks, Padlocks, Smart Locks)
  • Door Hinges (Butt Hinges, Concealed Hinges)
  • Sliding Tracks (Drawer Slides, Wardrobe Tracks)
  • Sofa Legs (Metal, Wooden, Plastic)
  • Cabinet Hardware (Handles, Knobs, Connectors)

Q: What materials do you use?

A: We use high-quality materials:

  • Stainless Steel: SS304, SS316
  • Zinc Alloy: High-grade zinc alloy
  • Aluminum: 6063 Aluminum Alloy
  • Iron: High-strength iron plate
  • Brass: Solid brass for premium products
